title: Rory and the Sleepy Silver Shadow
verses:
The sun went down behind the hills,
The shadows started to grow,
And Rory walked along the path,
Where quiet breezes blow.

Now Tilly paused to take a rest,
Beside a sleepy stream,
While Benny stretched his long green neck,
To watch a cozy dream.

Then Ricky settled in the leaves,
And curled his tiny feet,
While Psittaco tucked safely in,
To find a warm retreat.

High up above the sleepy trees,
Nia swooped down so low,
She whispered that the night was calm,
With soft moonlight aglow.

They made a cozy bedtime spot,
Upon the mossy ground,
And Rory gave a tiny yawn,
Without a single sound.

The stars shone bright across the sky,
To light the night so deep,
And all the dinos closed their eyes,
And softly fell asleep.
